repair_scope: Measurement repair only; Palomar corpus, archive scope, validation targets, hot-pixel criterion, and recovery thresholds remain fixed.
measurement_repairs: Recovery is evaluated locally at the preregistered injection coordinate instead of requiring the injected source to survive a global top-N source catalogue.
Injection positions must lie on clean local background patches with no >3-sigma positive structure before injection.
Injected PSF FWHM is relative to the frame's measured native PSF median, using ratios 0.8, 1.0, 1.2; the resolved-source floor remains 2.0 pixels.
Single-pixel hot impulses are evaluated by the same local PSF classifier at their known coordinates.

injection_recovery.frame_admission: all six preregistered validation frames must pass

unchanged_firewalls: No LUCI outcome changes the frozen Palomar 640-source corpus.
No UAP/nuclear/witness/temporal labels enter selection or source extraction.
Exact WCS containment and overlap-frame injection admission are required before counterpart inspection.
